subject: general
question: To which of the following classes do parrots belong?
solution:
Correct Answer **Aves**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Aves:

 
• The class Aves includes birds or flying vertebrates.
 
• A characteristic feature of Aves is the presence of feathers.
 
• The **birds** are unique in having a coat of feathers and in resting on the hindlimbs alone.
 
• Respiration takes place only by the lungs.
 
• Lungs are respiratory organs, which are spongy, inelastic, and are connected to large air sacs.
